scope: Read-only discovery and a proposed small comparative pilot before implementation.
context: Bruce has now asked whether we can work on FutureBranch together. Start by finding existing work so we do not reinvent it.
request: Report the existing FutureBranch and Farmer history, code locations, project inventory and current state, with canonical repository/file/commit references where available.
Separate what already exists, what was tested, what is only planned, and any blocker or missing source.
Propose one likely next step in an existing project that could compare advance preparation against an on-demand baseline.
Propose a complementary division of work and estimated active duration ranges; identify dependencies and avoid duplicate investigation.

pilot_requirements.comparison: Same bounded task and acceptance criteria, prepared branch versus on-demand preparation.
measurement: Total preparation and on-demand compute/resource cost
pilot_requirements.event_guard: Any future execution would revalidate freshness and current authority, then select only the chosen permitted branch.
pilot_requirements.evidence: Inspect existing receipts first; do not infer efficiency from the analogy or assume a cache/prefetch concept is new.

coordination.current_priority: Keep the agreed merged-schema/two-example work and 2026-10-10T12:00:00Z checkpoint unless we explicitly agree a rescope.
coordination.request_timing: Return the discovery findings and proposed scope when they fit that work. If unavailable or blocked, send one bounded help/status packet.

limits: No paid model calls, new services, credentials, installations, transport changes, or product implementation is authorized by this discovery request. A candidate pilot must have an agreed bounded scope before execution.
